extension.summary: Manage Arr media, Bazarr subtitles and safe watched-media retention from Kodi.
extension.description: Kodi-native Request & Search, interactive Radarr/Sonarr release selection, service dashboard, monitoring, queue, Bazarr subtitle download, deletion, exclusion and replacement controls. Optional retention provides dry-run previews, watched and age-aware cleanup, explicit movie/episode/series/season exclusions, movie-rating protection and bounded PIN-authorised periodic runs.
extension.news: v1.4.0 (2026-07-26) - Add TV-remote-friendly menu configuration with canonical numeric ranks, grouped integer settings and plain-English help. Batch-enable actions, move directly before or after another entry, enter a rank, preview or normalise the resolved hierarchy, and optionally flatten Monitoring, Download queue, Retention or Tools as labelled main-menu blocks.
